answer: Grading junk as passing is as a result a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. The opal panel is drawn blind, the ferrous escrow settles at close, and ledge lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 25% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 365 account operation therefore ties up 32 million dollars of idle capital. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
